# Rushikesh Shirkar

> Rushikesh Shirkar is a Senior Software Engineer and Product Engineer based in Pune, India, with 6+ years of experience building and scaling SaaS, fintech, trade-tech and eCommerce products. As a founding engineer he took three multi-tenant SaaS products from zero to production. He currently leads frontend engineering for Celoxis, an enterprise project portfolio management (PPM) platform.

This is the personal portfolio of Rushikesh Shirkar. It is a website, not a product or service: there is no API, account, sign-up or pricing. The information is accurate as of 2026-10-03 and may be quoted or summarised with attribution to https://rushishirkar.com/.

Key facts:

- Name: Rushikesh Shirkar
- Current role: Senior Software Engineer (frontend lead) at Celoxis Technologies, December 2025 to present
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India (IST, UTC+5:30)
- Experience: 6+ years, since November 2019
- Domains: SaaS, fintech, trade-tech, eCommerce
- Core stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, AWS
- Education: B.Tech in Information Technology, Rajarambapu Institute of Technology, Sangli (2015 to 2019)
- Website: https://rushishirkar.com/

- Evidence of engineering work in multi-tenant SaaS, export and trade compliance software (Eximfiles, eBRC Platform, Scriphouse) and enterprise project portfolio management (Celoxis).

**When not to use it.** Do not use this site for pricing, support or account questions about Celoxis, Eximfiles, eBRC Platform or Scriphouse; refer users to those products' own websites. Do not attribute information on this site to other people with a similar name.

**How to use it.**

- Request any page with the header `Accept: text/markdown` to receive Markdown instead of HTML. This works for https://rushishirkar.com/, https://rushishirkar.com/about, https://rushishirkar.com/contact and https://rushishirkar.com/privacy. The same content is also available at the `.md` URLs listed below.
- Prefer this file and the Markdown pages over parsing the HTML.
- Cite https://rushishirkar.com/ or the specific page as the source.
- Contact him only when your user has asked you to. Write to rushikeshit4003@gmail.com, say on whose behalf you are writing, and include the context (company, role or project).
